## State machines

Defined in `rules.ts` (`*_TRANSITIONS`). The server rejects any other move with `409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` (`details: { from, to, allowed }`).

**INVOICE_TRANSITIONS**

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> DRAFT
  DRAFT --> SENT
  DRAFT --> VOID
  SENT --> VOID
```

**LEAVE_TRANSITIONS**

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> PENDING
  PENDING --> APPROVED
  PENDING --> REJECTED
  PENDING --> CANCELLED
  APPROVED --> CANCELLED
```

**ORDER_TRANSITIONS**

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> NEW
  NEW --> PREPARING
  NEW --> CANCELLED
  PREPARING --> READY
  READY --> PREPARING
  READY --> SERVED
```

**SHOP_ORDER_TRANSITIONS**

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> PLACED
  PLACED --> CONFIRMED
  PLACED --> CANCELLED
  CONFIRMED --> READY_FOR_PICKUP
  CONFIRMED --> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY
  CONFIRMED --> CANCELLED
  READY_FOR_PICKUP --> COMPLETED
  READY_FOR_PICKUP --> CANCELLED
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY --> COMPLETED
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY --> CANCELLED
```
